This overview never grew past a placeholder and an image embedded by
absolute local path, so it rendered for nobody but its author. The content
it promised -- what the `tales` and `tales_msa` objects are, and how they
relate -- is now written, and better placed as pkgdown articles rather than
a numbered vignette: see [the `tales` class](../articles/tales-class.html)
and [the `tales_msa` class](../articles/tales-msa-class.html).
